ex.en: I opened the cookbook at a random page.
ex.zh: 我随手翻开了食谱中的一页。

ex.en: Researchers selected a random sample of households to assess public attitudes towards renewable energy.
ex.zh: 研究人员随机抽取了一些家庭，以评估公众对可再生能源的态度。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 3 B。random是形容词；作状语用randomly或at random。

senses.zh: 使…兴高采烈；感到快乐（delight的过去分词）

ex.en: Lina was delighted to find her missing bracelet.
ex.zh: 莉娜找到丢失的手链，非常高兴。

ex.en: Residents were delighted with the new library, which offered free internet access and a welcoming space for study.
ex.zh: 居民对新图书馆感到十分满意，那里提供免费上网服务和舒适宜人的学习空间。

col: delighted with the result｜对结果非常满意
delighted to hear｜听到后很高兴
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 3 B。人感到高兴用delighted；事物令人愉快用delightful。
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 3 B

senses.zh: 谦逊的；简陋的；（级别或地位）低下的；不大的
使谦恭；轻松打败（尤指强大的对手）；低声下气

ex.en: Despite winning the prize, she remained humble and thanked everyone.
ex.zh: 尽管获了奖，她依然谦逊，并向所有人表示感谢。

ex.en: Effective leaders remain humble enough to acknowledge mistakes and learn from colleagues with different backgrounds and experiences.
ex.zh: 优秀的领导者保持谦逊，愿意承认错误，并向背景和经历不同的同事学习。

col: in my humble opinion｜依我拙见
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 3 B。谦逊是humble；不要与“羞辱”humiliate混淆。

ex.en: He sprinkled a handful of nuts over his breakfast.
ex.zh: 他在早餐上撒了一把坚果。

ex.en: Only a handful of rural communities have reliable public transport, limiting residents' access to employment and healthcare.
ex.zh: 只有少数农村社区拥有可靠的公共交通，这限制了居民获得就业机会和医疗服务。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 3 B。a handful of可接不可数名词或复数名词。

senses.zh: 使弯曲；使屈服；使致力；使朝向
弯曲，转弯；屈服；倾向；专心于

ex.en: Bend the wire gently to make a small hook.
ex.zh: 轻轻弯曲铁丝，做成一个小钩子。

ex.en: Drivers should reduce their speed before approaching a sharp bend, especially when road conditions are poor.
ex.zh: 驾驶员在接近急弯前应减速，尤其是在路况不佳时。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 3 B。过去式和过去分词均为bent；bend down表示弯下腰。
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 3 B

ex.en: She brought fresh flowers to express her gratitude.
ex.zh: 她带来鲜花表达感激之情。

ex.en: Schools can encourage gratitude by helping students recognise the contributions that others make to their daily lives.
ex.zh: 学校可以帮助学生认识到他人对自己日常生活的贡献，从而培养感恩之心。

col: gratitude to someone｜对某人的感激
gratitude for something｜对某事的感激
a token of gratitude｜一点谢意
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 3 B。对人感激用to，对某事感激用for；通常不可数。

senses.zh: 引擎，发动机；机车，火车头；工具

ex.en: The engine stopped just as we reached the driveway.
ex.zh: 我们刚到车道入口，发动机就熄火了。

ex.en: Cleaner engine technology can reduce air pollution, although expanding public transport remains essential for sustainable urban travel.
ex.zh: 更清洁的发动机技术可以减少空气污染，但扩大公共交通仍是实现城市可持续出行的关键。

col: an engine of growth｜增长的推动力
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 3 B。engine多指燃料发动机；电动机通常用motor。

senses.zh: 流动，涌流；川流不息；飘扬

ex.en: Rainwater flowed down the path and into the garden.
ex.zh: 雨水沿着小路流进了花园。

ex.en: Improved public transport can ease the flow of traffic and reduce air pollution in crowded cities.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以使交通更加顺畅，并减少拥挤城市的空气污染。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 3 B。过去式和过去分词均为flowed，不是flew。

senses.zh: 点灯；照亮；点香烟；变快活

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 3 B
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 3 B
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A

ex.en: I arranged to meet my cousin outside the cinema.
ex.zh: 我约好和表亲在电影院外见面。

ex.en: Schools can arrange visits to local businesses to help students understand the practical demands of different careers.
ex.zh: 学校可以安排学生参观当地企业，帮助他们了解不同职业的实际要求。

col: arrange for someone to do something｜安排某人做某事
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A。安排某人做某事用arrange for sb to do。

ex.en: Please keep your bicycle off the crowded sidewalk.
ex.zh: 请不要把自行车骑上拥挤的人行道。

ex.en: Planting trees along sidewalks can provide shade for pedestrians and reduce summer temperatures in cities.
ex.zh: 沿人行道植树可以为行人遮阴，并降低城市夏季的气温。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A。美式sidewalk对应英式pavement。

senses.zh: 隆隆作响；喃喃地讲话（rumble的ing形式）

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A

ex.en: A sudden clap of thunder made the windows shake.
ex.zh: 一声突如其来的雷鸣震得窗户直晃。

ex.en: Outdoor sports events should be suspended when thunder indicates that a storm is dangerously close.
ex.zh: 当雷声表明雷暴已逼近到危险距离时，应暂停户外体育赛事。

col: a clap of thunder｜一声雷响
a rumble of thunder｜低沉的隆隆雷声
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A。thunder指雷声，通常不可数；lightning指闪电。

ex.en: We watched colourful fireworks explode above the lake.
ex.zh: 我们看着五彩烟花在湖面上空绽放。

ex.en: Demand for online courses has exploded as more adults seek flexible opportunities to develop new skills.
ex.zh: 随着更多成年人寻求灵活的机会来培养新技能，在线课程的需求激增。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A。爆炸物作主语常用主动形式，不必用被动。

senses.zh: 层，层次；膜；压条；放置者，计划者
把…分层堆放；借助压条法；生根繁殖；将（头发）剪成不同层次
形成或分成层次；通过压条法而生根

ex.en: A thin layer of dust covered the shelf.
ex.zh: 架子上覆盖着薄薄的一层灰尘。

ex.en: Adding an extra layer of insulation can significantly reduce energy consumption in older homes.
ex.zh: 增加一层保温材料可以显著降低老旧住宅的能源消耗。

col: a layer of dust｜一层灰尘
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A。“一层某物”用a layer of；layer也可作动词。

ex.en: I ripped my sleeve on a sharp branch yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我的袖子被一根尖树枝扯破了。

ex.en: Repairing a small rip in clothing instead of replacing it can reduce household waste.
ex.zh: 修补衣物上的小裂口而非换掉整件衣物，可以减少家庭垃圾。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A。rip的过去式和过去分词均为ripped。

ex.en: The branches swayed gently as we ate outside.
ex.zh: 我们在户外吃饭时，树枝轻轻摇曳。

ex.en: Emotional advertising can sway consumers' decisions even when competing products offer better value for money.
ex.zh: 即使竞争产品更划算，情感广告仍可能左右消费者的决定。

col: sway public opinion｜左右公众舆论
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A。sway既可指身体摇摆，也可指影响观点或决定。

senses.zh: 使倒塌，使崩溃；使萎陷；折叠

ex.en: The old garden shed collapsed during last night's storm.
ex.zh: 昨晚的暴风雨中，花园里的旧棚屋倒塌了。

ex.en: Poor maintenance can cause bridges to collapse, making regular inspections essential for public safety.
ex.zh: 维护不善可能导致桥梁坍塌，因此定期检查对公共安全至关重要。

col: collapse from exhaustion｜因筋疲力尽而倒下
the collapse of negotiations｜谈判破裂
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A。表示倒塌或崩溃时通常是不及物动词，不用被动。

senses.zh: 块，块状；肿块；瘤；很多；笨人
混在一起；使成块状；忍耐；笨重地移动

ex.en: She dropped a lump of clay onto the table.
ex.zh: 她把一团黏土放到了桌子上。

ex.en: Policymakers should not lump all unemployed people together, as their circumstances and support needs vary considerably.
ex.zh: 政策制定者不应把所有失业者一概而论，因为他们的处境和援助需求差异很大。

col: a lump of clay｜一团黏土
a lump sum｜一次性支付的款项
lump together｜不加区别地归为一类
a lump in your throat｜哽咽感
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A。lump together常暗示忽略差异，笼统归类。

senses.zh: 摔倒；倒塌；滚动；打滚；仓惶地行动

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A

senses.zh: 减轻；粘贴；涂以灰泥；敷以膏药；使平服

ex.en: Small pieces of plaster fell from the kitchen ceiling.
ex.zh: 小块灰泥从厨房天花板上掉了下来。

ex.en: Restoring historic buildings often requires skilled workers who can repair damaged plaster without harming original decorative features.
ex.zh: 修复历史建筑往往需要熟练工人，他们能在不损坏原有装饰的情况下修补受损灰泥。

col: a coat of plaster｜一层灰泥
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A。表灰泥时通常不可数；英式英语中a plaster是创可贴。

senses.zh: 粉碎；打碎；破坏；破掉；使散开

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A

ex.en: My throat felt dry after talking all afternoon.
ex.zh: 说了一下午话后，我觉得喉咙很干。

ex.en: Poor air quality can irritate the throat and worsen breathing problems, particularly among children and older adults.
ex.zh: 空气质量差会刺激咽喉并加重呼吸问题，儿童和老年人尤其容易受到影响。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A。喉咙痛用have a sore throat，注意冠词a。

ex.en: Hang your wet coat by the kitchen door.
ex.zh: 把你的湿外套挂在厨房门边。

ex.en: Applying a protective coat to metal structures can reduce maintenance costs and extend their useful life.
ex.zh: 给金属结构涂上保护层可以降低维护成本，延长其使用寿命。

col: a coat of paint｜一层油漆
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A。动词常用coat A with B，意为给A涂上B。
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A

ex.en: She poured warm milk into a large blue mug.
ex.zh: 她把温牛奶倒进一个蓝色的大杯子里。

ex.en: When factories pour untreated waste into rivers, they threaten aquatic ecosystems and nearby communities' drinking water.
ex.zh: 工厂将未经处理的废弃物排入河流时，会威胁水生生态系统及附近社区的饮用水安全。

col: pour money into｜向……投入大量资金
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A。倒入用pour into；倒出用pour out of。

senses.zh: 溢出，溅出；溢出量；摔下；小塞子

ex.en: I spilled orange juice all over my clean shirt.
ex.zh: 我把橙汁洒得干净衬衫上到处都是。

ex.en: Oil spills can damage marine ecosystems and threaten the livelihoods of communities that depend on fishing.
ex.zh: 石油泄漏会破坏海洋生态系统，并威胁依赖捕鱼的社区的生计。

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A。过去式和过去分词可用spilled或spilt。

senses.zh: 激烈的；狂怒的；热烈兴奋的；喧闹的

ex.en: Lena was furious when someone scratched her new bicycle.
ex.zh: 有人刮花了莉娜的新自行车，她气坏了。

ex.en: Residents were furious about the sudden closure of a public park without any community consultation.
ex.zh: 一座公园未经任何社区协商就突然关闭，居民对此十分愤怒。

col: furious with someone｜对某人大发雷霆
furious about something｜因某事极其愤怒
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A。对某人生气用with，因某事生气用about。

senses.zh: 不稳定的；不规则的；摇摆的；无常的

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A

ex.en: Dust from the old rug made me sneeze.
ex.zh: 旧地毯扬起的灰尘让我打了喷嚏。

ex.en: Covering your mouth and nose when you sneeze helps reduce the spread of respiratory infections.
ex.zh: 打喷嚏时遮住口鼻有助于减少呼吸道感染的传播。

col: sneeze into a tissue｜对着纸巾打喷嚏
a fit of sneezing｜一阵喷嚏
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A。动词不及物；“打一个喷嚏”可说give a sneeze。

senses.zh: 伸展,张开；（大量地）使用，消耗（金钱，时间）；使竭尽所能；使全力以赴；

tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A

ex.en: The mayor opened our new swimming pool yesterday.
ex.zh: 市长昨天为我们的新游泳馆主持了启用仪式。

ex.en: The newly elected mayor has promised to improve public transport and create more affordable housing for residents.
ex.zh: 新当选的市长承诺改善公共交通，并为居民提供更多可负担住房。

col: the mayor of a city｜一座城市的市长
tip: 📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A。mayor是市长，别与major（主要的）混淆。
📘 选必2 Reading Unit 4 A
